title: Ping It!
description: Adds a smart ping system for easier communication. You can now point at a location, mob or item
body: **Ping It!** is a utility mod that introduces a convenient pinging and marking system to Minecraft. It allows players on a server to easily point out locations, blocks, containers, items, and entities to each other without using chat or voice communication. ## Key Features * **Quick World Pings**: Place markers on block coordinates, ores, mobs, and dropped items instantly by pressing the hotkey (default: V). Hostile mobs are highlighted as danger, and blocks like signs have their text displayed on the ping card. Pinging fluids is also supported. * **Interactive Radial Menu**: Hold down the hotkey (default: V) to open a wheel selection where you can select the ping type (Look, Alert, Danger) or choose from a customizable pool of quick chat phrases. * **Container Inventory Pings**: Press the hotkey (default: V) while hovering over slot items inside chests, hoppers, or your player inventory to cycle between different alert types (Look, Alert, Danger) and share the item details. * **Smart Raycasting**: Raycasts automatically ignore grass, flowers, and vines. You can configure the mod to ignore glass, torches, and barrier blocks. * **Waypoint Routes (in beta)**: Connect multiple coordinates into a custom route to guide your team through cave systems or build areas. Press the route key (default: B) to start and publish routes. * **Creative Teleportation**: Creative and spectator mode players can middle-click an active ping on their screen to teleport safely to its location. * **Top Compass HUD**(our ~~flagman~~ feature): A horizontal compass bar showing direction headings and nearby ping markers... * **Off-screen Indicators**: Arrow, sonar, and distance indicators at screen edges for pings outside your field of view. * **And Much More!** ## How to Use * **Press Key**: Send a quick ping at your crosshair. * **Hold Key**: Open the radial menu to select a specific ping type, customize labels, or choose a quick chat phrase. * **Press Key on Container Slot**: Highlights the specific item in the chest or inventory slot. ## Configuration Almost every aspect of the mod is fully customizable to suit your gameplay preferences. The mod features a fully translated, comprehensive configuration screen, with presets, UI styles (including Vanilla-style (20/80) HUD), color adjustments, block outlines, fading options, and distance-based sound volume falloff. _This mod works fully client-side when playing on vanilla servers (only you will see your pings), but will synchronize with other players if installed on the server._ ## Credits * **[Noxbane](https://github.com/NoxbaneSudo)** - Developer * **Kylon** - Artist **Testers** * **VenTylator**
